module.name: TIDAL
module.author: morieattonkatsu
module.description: Plays songs from TIDAL with your own TIDAL subscription. Supports FLAC lossless, Hi-Res FLAC through DASH, and AAC. Provide an access token, or a refresh token with its client ID so the module can renew access automatically. Protected (DRM) and encrypted streams are not played, and previews are never returned as full tracks.

accessToken.label: Access token
accessToken.description: OAuth access token for your TIDAL account. Optional when a refresh token and client ID are set.

refreshToken.label: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for your TIDAL account. Used with the client ID to renew expired access tokens.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.description: Client ID of the application that issued your tokens. Required for automatic renewal.

clientSecret.label: Client secret
clientSecret.description: Only needed when the client that issued your tokens requires a secret for renewal.

countryCode.label: Country code
countryCode.description: Two-letter catalog region, such as US. Leave empty to use your account's region.

qualityOptions.label: Max · Hi-Res FLAC
qualityOptions.description: Up to 24-bit/192 kHz FLAC delivered through DASH. TIDAL returns lossless when a track or client has no Hi-Res version.

qualityOptions.label: High · FLAC 16-bit/44.1 kHz
qualityOptions.description: CD-quality FLAC as a single file.

qualityOptions.label: Data saver · AAC 96 kbps
qualityOptions.description: AAC at 96 kbps to reduce data usage.
